parse_slot_string: parse a comma-separated slot annotation string into a list of Slot objects with label, start, and end offsets
align_slot_labels: align slot labels to token ranges and return a space-separated BIO or flat label sequence for sequence labeling
merge_token_labels_to_slot: merge per-token labels back into slot annotations with start, end offsets and entity type labels
get_substring_from_offsets: extract a substring from text using byte or character offsets with optional UTF-8 byte offset support
char_offset_to_byte_offset: convert a character offset position to its corresponding byte offset for UTF-8 encoded text
